description: This file defines models, query parameters, and a fetcher class for interacting with the FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data) API, specifically for Personal Consumption Expenditures data. It includes data validation, request transformation, data extraction, and transformation logic.

classes.name: FredPersonalConsumptionExpendituresQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching Personal Consumption Expenditures data, including category and date validation.

classes.name: FredPersonalConsumptionExpendituresData
classes.description: Data model representing individual observation records for Personal Consumption Expenditures from the FRED API.

classes.name: FredPersonalConsumptionExpendituresFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class that handles transforming queries, fetching data asynchronously from the FRED API, and converting raw data into structured data models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters dictionary into a strongly typed query parameter model.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from the FRED API based on the query parameters, processes JSON responses into pandas DataFrames, and returns a list of dictionaries representing records.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw data dictionaries into structured data model instances, ensuring data is sorted and validated.
